label: Language Tree Hub
description: Central language layer for intent, abstraction, semantics, expression and cross-domain association.

layers.label: Intent
layers.purpose: Turn a user goal into a scoped route request.

layers.label: Lexicon
layers.purpose: Maintain names, terms, aliases and controlled vocabulary.

layers.label: Grammar
layers.purpose: Represent structural constraints, valid transformations and operation forms.

layers.label: Semantics
layers.purpose: Map meaning, abstraction level, evidence and cross-domain relations.

layers.label: Expression
layers.purpose: Prepare task-facing summaries, instructions, UI text and implementation notes.

layers.label: Validation
layers.purpose: Bind claims to tests, evidence, route outcomes and FAME updates.
